<entry id="E00147">
<head-word>הָדַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="H00212"> cmp. חדר</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> חזר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to enclose, go around.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Part. pass</italic>. הָדוּר </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rounded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup> הֲדוּרוֹת בעינן Ar. (ed. חֲדוּרוֹת, v. חָדַר) the horns must de rounded (not flat; Ar.: showing circular layers).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>distinguished, adorned, beautiful</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 60 (ref. to הלזה, Gen. XXIV, 25) ראתה אותו ה' she saw his commanding appearance; Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, end.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִדֵּר, הִי'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to crown, adorn, distinguish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 30 שהִדְּרוֹ הקב"ה וכ' whom the Lord crowned with old age. Kidd. 32
<sup>b</sup> יְהַדְּרֶנּוּ בממון that he must show him honor even at a material sacrifice; a. e.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְהוּדָּר. Lev. R. s. 3 שיהא המזבח מה' וכ' that the altar may appear adorned by the poor man’s offering; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go around searching</italic>, whence 
<italic>to be zealous in religious observances, to look out for the best method of doing good</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 21
<sup>b</sup> המְהַדְּרִין the zealous, המה' מן המה' the most zealous. V. הִידּוּר.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְהַדֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be crowned, glorified</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 1 הוא לבדו מִתְהַדֵּר וכ' He alone is glorified through His world.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="E00148">
<head-word>הֲדַר</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(preced.) 
<italic>to go around, come back, return</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. III, 19; a. fr.—B. Mets. 14
<sup>a</sup> what thou takest from him, עלי דידי ה' comes back on my property (I am responsible for it). Ib. 69
<sup>b</sup> הַדְרָא בעינא is returned bodily. Pes. 29
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ה' ביה went back on himself, changed his opinion. B. Mets. 65
<sup>a</sup> הַדְרִי בי I take it back. B. Bath. 84
<sup>a</sup> לא מצית הַדְרַת בך וכ' thou wouldst not have been at liberty to retract (the transaction), and now thou shouldst &c.?; a. fr. [Frequ. used adverbially.] B. Mets. 6
<sup>a</sup> שתיק מעיקרא וה' צוח first he kept silence and then (reconsidering) he protested. Gitt. 8
<sup>b</sup> ה' אמר אביי another time A. said. Ḥull. 76
<sup>b</sup> (הדר) הֲדוּר שלחו another time they sent word; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הַדּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="E00147">preced.</xref>
<italic>Pi.</italic>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to honor, distinguish.</italic></definition>
<notes> Dan. IV, 31.—Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 15 (ed. Berl. תַהְדּר 
<italic>Af</italic>.).—B. Bath. 3
<sup>b</sup> הַדְּרֵי, v. הוּדְרָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go around searching, be zealous, anxious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 76
<sup>b</sup>; Nidd. 65
<sup>b</sup> הַדּוּרֵי אפירכא what need is there to go around searching for an argument (why do you resort to unknown authorities)? Sabb. 23
<sup>a</sup> הוה מְהַדֵּר מר וכ' my teacher used to be anxious for puppy-oil. Ib. מהדרא אמשחא (read: מהדר אמ'); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restore;</italic></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to review;</italic> v. 
<italic>Af</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַהֲדַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> l) 
<italic>to return, restore; to lead back; to turn around</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. XXXII, 3 (some ed. 
<italic>Pa</italic>.). Targ. Cant. VII, 5; a. fr.—B. Mets. 26
<sup>a</sup> אי … לאַהֲדוּרָהּ אַהַדְרוּהָ ניהלי if they had had the intention of returning it, they would have returned it to me. Ib. אמרי קמייהו … לִיהַדְּרוּ לי ולא הַדְּרוּ לי וכ' (differ. in Mss., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) I spoke in their presence several times (of my loss); they might have returned it to me, but did not; will they now return it?—Ḥull. 20
<sup>a</sup> בדלא א' when he did not turn round (the windpipe &c.). Ḥag. 5
<sup>b</sup> עמא דַאֲהַדְרִינְהוּ … מיניה a people from which its master has turned away his face; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>to repeat, review</italic>. M. Kat. 28
<sup>a</sup> אֲהַדְרִי לתלמודאי that I may review my studies. Ber. 38
<sup>b</sup> מַהֲדַר תלמודיה (or מְהַדֵּר); a. fr.—3) 
<italic>to reply</italic>. Ḥull. 34
<sup>a</sup> מאי אהדרי 
<pgbrk id="pg335" />וכ' what did … reply to one another?; a. e.—4) 
<italic>to carry around in procession</italic>. Yeb. 110
<sup>a</sup> Ar., v. כּוּרְסַיָּא; v. אֲדוּרֵי.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיהַדַּר, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיהֲדַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go around begging</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup> אַהֲדוּרֵי אפיתחא לא מִיהֲדַר he will not be forced to go around begging.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go back</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. 50
<sup>a</sup> איהדר לאחורי I will go back again.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="E00165">
<head-word>*הִדְרָנִיקוֹס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (a corrupt. of ὑδερικός or ὑδρωπικός, cmp. הִדְרוֹקָן; for Var. lect.</definition>
<notes> v. infra) 
<italic>one afflicted with dropsy</italic>. Ber. 58
<sup>b</sup> ואת הננס ואת ה' (Ms. M. ואת הרדינקס, Ms. F. והננס ה'); Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 3 (absent in ed. Zuck., added in note); Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 10 … הבהקנין ואת דרניקוס; ed. Bub. ib. 1 ואת הדרקונוס … הננס (Mss. הדריקינוס, הדרקוניס); Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>b</sup> bot. (absent); [absent in Bekh. VII, 6, among bodily blemishes disqualifying for priestly service]. [Our w. is obviously a gloss to one of the anomalies enumerated in the text, prob. to קִפֵּחַ.—Ar. reads והברדניקוס, in the place of קפח in our text, giving it the meaning of כִּיפֵּחַ q. v., but records also הדר' in letter 
<italic>He;</italic> Alf. reads בדריקנוס, בדרקינוס, leaving out קפח.—For other definitions of our w., v. commentaries.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to exist; to be, become; to occur, come to pass</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—With part. ה' מביט 
<italic>he looked;</italic> ה' אומר 
<italic>he said</italic>, freq. 
<italic>used to say</italic>. Gen. R. s. 1, beg. אני הָיִיתִי וכ' I was the implement &c. Ib. ה' הקב"ה מביט וכ' the Lord looked into the Law (as often as a thing was to be created). Ab. I, 13 הוא ה' אומר the same used to say. Gen. R. s. 2 ה' ללמה ולא כלום became a nothing; a. v. fr.—Apocopate forms: אֱהִי, אֱהֵא, תְּהִי, תְּהֵא, יְהִי, יְהֵא; תְּהוּ (= תִּהְיוּ), יְהוּ (= יִהְיוּ). Yoma 66
<sup>b</sup> אהא בשלום אני נכ' (Tosef. ib. IV (III), 14 נִהְיֶה) may I and you be as well; Y. ib. VI, 43
<sup>c</sup> bot. כן תהו וכ' so may ye be well. B. Mets. 35
<sup>a</sup> תהא במאמינו let this be (speak of a case) when he accepts his opponent’s statement; a. v. fr.—Part. הֹוֶה, הֹוֶוה </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>frequent, usual</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. VI, 6 דברו חכמים בה' the scholars (in using the words ‘Arabian women’) speak of the ordinary custom (not to the exclusion of other people); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>existing, enduring</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 11, end הם הוֹוִים ודומים [להקב"ה] they shall be existing for themselves (not merely as an attachment) and resembling [the Lord]; ib. אף הם הווים אש וכ' they, too, shall endure as a consuming fire.—Cant. R. to II, 13 עניות ירבה ויוקר הווה (read תרבה) poverty shall increase, and prices remain high (different in Snh. 97
<sup>a</sup> a. Sot. 49
<sup>b</sup>, v. אָמַר II). 
<italic>Imper</italic>. הֱוֵי, הֱוֵא; pl. הֱווּ. Ab. I, 4. Ib. II, 3; a. fr.—הֱוֵי אוֹמֵר, also elliptically הֱוֵי 
<italic>say</italic>, i.e. 
<italic>you must admit, this proves, that is meant by saying</italic>. Taan. 2
<sup>a</sup> which is the service of the heart? ה' אומר זו תפלה you must admit, it is prayer. Tosef. Nidd. I, 6 ה' לא אמרום וכ' that is to say, the scholars have spoken &c. Cant. R. to I, 6 ה' כרמי שלי וכ' this is meant by ‘my vineyard &c.’—Y. Shebu. VII, 38
<sup>c</sup> top הווי לא צורכה וכ' it is evident that it would not have been necessary &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<language-key>(b. h. </language-key> interj.</definition>

<italic>helakh, the instantaneous delivery of the amount confessed</italic>, while the creditor claims a larger amount. <sup>b</sup> הי מינייהו which of them (eventually closes up a hole in the entrails); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<sense>
